description: Reference numbers for tests/external_parity/test_did_paper_gallery.py. Paper numbers are copied with the decimals the source prints. Stata numbers are the full-precision outputs of Stata 18 MP runs on the same data bytes (SHA-256 pinned in statspai/datasets/_did_gallery.py and, for castle, the shipped castle_2013.csv), made for the 2026-10-21 '2026 学 DiD' replication series (case folders ep1-ep5, did_case.do).

santanna_zhao_2020.paper_source: Sant'Anna & Zhao (2020), arXiv:1812.01723v3 (May 2020), Section 5 & Table 3 'Evaluation bias of different DID estimators ... NSW data with CPS comparison group'; values in dollars, rounded to the dollar as printed. Checked 2026-10-21 against the arXiv v3 PDF, Table 3 (all 54 cells and SEs).
santanna_zhao_2020.stata_source: Stata 18 MP, drdid (Rios-Avila, Sant'Anna & Naqvi), one estimator per call (drimp / dripw / reg / stdipw / ipw / twfe), 'regress re treated, vce(robust)' for the benchmark; ep2 did_case.do

goodman_bacon_2021.paper_source: Goodman-Bacon (2021) JoE 225(2):254-277 Sec. 6; numbers read from NBER w25018 (Sept 2018) Sec. III + Fig. 5-6 and the July 2019 revision (identical numbers); JoE typeset version not accessed. Checked 2026-10-21 against the NBER w25018 PDF: DD -3.08 (s.e. 1.27 in Figure 5, 1.13 in the text), 156 components, weights / estimates 0.38 / -7.04, 0.24 / -5.33, 0.26 / 3.51, 0.11 / -0.19.
goodman_bacon_2021.stata_source: Stata 18 MP: reghdfe asmrs post, absorb(stfips year) vce(cluster stfips) (also vce(robust) / unadjusted); bacondecomp 1.0.5 asmrs post, ddetail; csdid asmrs, ivar(stfips) time(year) gvar(gvar) long2 + estat simple on the 41 states without the 8 pre-1964 reformers; ep3 did_case.do

callaway_santanna_2021.r_source: R did 2.5.1 documentation: 'Getting Started' vignette (att_gt, DR, never-treated, varying base) and ?aggte examples / README; printed to 4 decimals; R SEs are multiplier-bootstrap, so only point estimates are compared with R.
callaway_santanna_2021.stata_source: Stata 18 MP: csdid lemp, ivar(countyreal) time(year) gvar(first_treat) method(dripw) + estat pretrend / simple / group / calendar / event (analytic influence-function SEs); ep4 did_case.do
callaway_santanna_2021.r_analytic_source: R did 2.5.1, run 2026-10-21 as a black box: att_gt(yname='lemp', gname='first.treat', idname='countyreal', tname='year', xformla=~1, data=mpdta, est_method='dr', control_group='nevertreated', base_period='varying', bstrap=FALSE) and aggte(type=..., bstrap=FALSE); printed with format(digits=10).

cheng_hoekstra_2013.paper_source: Cheng & Hoekstra (2012), NBER WP 18134, Table 5 Panel A (log homicide, OLS weighted by population, SE clustered by state); published as JHR 48(3), 2013. Mixtape 1st ed. (mixtape.scunning.com, archived 2021-10-19) Table 9.7 reprints the same numbers; its Bacon-decomposition table reports TWFE 0.069 (0.034) (unweighted, post dummy), weights 0.899/0.077/0.024. Checked 2026-10-21 against the Wayback Machine copy (2021-10-19) of mixtape.scunning.com/difference-in-differences.html, Table 9.7 Panel A: 0.0801 (0.0342) and 0.0946 (0.0279).
cheng_hoekstra_2013.stata_source: Stata 18 MP: reghdfe l_homicide <x> [aw=popwt], absorb(sid year | sid region#year) vce(cluster sid) for x in cdl / post / D=1[year>=effyear]; csdid l_homicide [iw=popwt], ivar(sid) time(year) gvar(gvar) long2 method(reg) + estat simple / event; ep5 did_case.do

baker_et_al_jel.paper_source: pedrohcgs/JEL-DiD tables/table2_R.tex, table5_R.tex, table7_R.tex at commit affb8f69f6975652445adbc727a50ea04b2c7bd8 (the authors' replication output for the JEL article's Tables 2, 5 and 7); Table 2 prints 1 decimal, Tables 5 and 7 print 2.
baker_et_al_jel.stata_source: Stata 18 MP: reg y i.Treat##i.Post [aw=set_wt], vce(cluster county_code); drdid y $COVS [iw=set_wt], ivar(county_code) time(year) tr(Treat) reg / stdipw / dripw pscoretrim(0.995) with covariates fixed at 2013; reghdfe y D $COVS [aw=set_wt], absorb(county_code year) vce(cluster county_code); staggered: reghdfe y D [aw=set_wt] / unweighted, bacondecomp y D, ddetail; csdid y, ivar(county_code) time(year) gvar(treat_year) notyet long2 + estat simple; ep1 did_case.do
